verdict.rationale: Payout reconciliation is a fair axis for a payments platform and merchant of record, so the story applies. The evidence shows a general API and webhooks, but nothing documents payout or balance-transaction endpoints, or any way to map bank deposits to the charges behind them. A community mention of payout fees says nothing about API access to payout data.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges
